channel.title: San Francisco Public Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Francisco Public Press (sfpublicpress.org)

item.title: Film Screening: ‘No Place to Grow Old’
item.description: Join the San Francisco Public Press for a screening of “No Place to Grow Old,” about the rising crisis of older adults facing homelessness.

item.title: Screening: Two Films on Crossing State Lines for Abortion Access
item.description: We will screen two short films that shed light on the political and economic challenges of accessing abortions and reproductive health care.

item.title: As Federal Subsidy Ends, Hundreds of Families Need to Move
item.description: A federal housing assistance program affecting more than 900 San Francisco households will expire sooner than expected.

item.title: Mayor’s Budget Proposal Sparks Debate Over SF Climate Priorities
item.description: San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie’s recommended budget would reduce city support for the Environment Department.

item.title: Following CA Lead, NY Says AI Firms Need Not Warn of Dangers
item.description: New York legislators proposed requiring AI companies to warn if their chatbots might cause harm, but facing heavy lobbying, they backtracked.

item.title: Billionaire Money, Ballot Power and the Fight Over San Francisco’s CEO Tax
item.description: While national debate focuses on the role of billionaires in politics, San Francisco voters are confronting a local test case.Six-figure checks from prominent tech investors and business leaders have fueled a ballot fight over the city’s executive pay tax.

item.title: Residentes latinos exigen mejores condiciones
item.description: Las infestaciones de plagas y otros problemas fueron tan ignoradas por la administración que la ciudad optó por escalar el caso de las viviendas de una habitación a una audiencia.

item.title: Livestream of Community Congressional Candidates Forum
item.description: We will livestream the March 14 Asian American Community Congressional Candidates Forum at Victory Hall in San Francisco’s Chinatown.

item.title: Federal Pressure on Transgender Care Reaches SF Clinics
item.description: A sweeping federal campaign to curb gender-affirming care for minors is testing the limits of Washington’s authority over medicine.

item.title: In Chinatown, Rival Clubs Join Forces to Press Congressional Candidates
item.description: Competing for Nancy Pelosi’s seat, congressional candidates are taking divergent approaches to immigration and connecting with Chinese American voters.
